description: Read your saved checkpoint by stable id; defaults to full body. Use list_memory if you forgot the name. Private to this agent identity.

detail.description: metadata: identifiers; abstract: preview; claims: claim attributes; full: complete body. Default abstract, except get_memory defaults to full.

id.description: Stable private note name, scoped to the authenticated agent.

max_tokens.description: Estimated response budget: 3 UTF-8 bytes per token. Increase on BUDGET_TOO_SMALL.

name: get_memory

outputSchema.description: Structured result for get_memory. Resource fields vary by detail, permissions and operation. Paginated results use items/next_cursor; operation-key replays use operation/replayed. Failures have error and the MCP result has isError=true. See get_help for this tool's contract.
